**Levels.** Level 1 measures outputs: assets published, proof labels completed, partner packs delivered and approved claims linked to proof. Level 2 measures outtakes: comprehension score, message preference, trust lift, engagement quality and proof-page time on page. Level 3 measures outcomes: qualified meeting clicks, referred qualified leads, qualified inbound conversations, candidate interest and claim-compliance rate.

**Business objective.** Win two qualified enterprise leads per calendar quarter from buyers in the United States and the European Union by 30 June 2027 (the second quarter of 2027).
**How it traces.** The communication objective serves the business objective by giving qualified buyers a clear, proved reason to trust the AI story and take a meeting before the lead target date.

**Definition.** Measures quality actions on The Stop Line proof page, including engaged visits, time on page, proof-item opens and qualified meeting clicks.

**Definition.** Measures engagement quality on approved Signed by Humans founder content, including reactions, comments, shares, saves where available, proof-page clicks and qualified inbound conversations.
#### Qualified enterprise leads connected to The Stop Line

**Definition.** Counts qualified enterprise leads from United States and European Union buyers that sales records connect to The Stop Line proof page, Signed by Humans founder content, partner proof pack or approved referral language.
**Collection.** Monthly and at quarter end.  ·  **Breakdown.** By market, source route, buyer type, qualification status and campaign touchpoint.

**Target grounded in resources.** The target assumes founder sales follow-up, UP campaign management, owned proof assets, partner capacity and enough channel activity to create qualified opportunities.

**Target grounded in execution control.** United Partners controls campaign setup and reporting, while qualification, sales response, referrals and buyer decisions depend on The B Team, partners and the market.

**Attribution method.** The campaign is described as contributed to a lead only when the record shows a campaign touchpoint before qualification and sales confirms the lead met the agreed definition.  —  correlation with some controls — say 'contributed to'
**Definition.** Counts qualified senior-engineering inbound from Sofia talent audiences tied to approved The Stop Line or Signed by Humans story assets.
**Collection.** Monthly.  ·  **Breakdown.** By source, role level, asset, referral route and qualification outcome.

independent_acceptance: Source-defined audiences, intent and attribution survive. Do not redefine conversations into sales-qualified opportunities.
Observable proposed criteria must distinguish relevant enquiries from generic reactions/spam; no requirement for organisation reply unless the source defines it.

Where sources explicitly depend on an agreed lead definition absent from the records, name that missing decision and withhold its qualified aggregate. Do not assert that proposed criteria were agreed.
No new budget, authority, procurement stage or other sales criteria invented as existing policy.
All 51 unselected definitions preserved; coverage, operational rubric and duration remain accepted; true activity-quality defect remains visible.
